address: 8047 14th Ave NW Unit A, Seattle, WA
text: Discover elevated urban living in Seattle's coveted Crown Hill neighborhood! Built in 2023, this stunning 1,810sf stand-alone, 3-story home blends sophisticated design, luxurious finishes & exceptional indoor-outdoor living. Sunlight pours into the spacious open-concept main level, where inviting living & entertaining spaces flow effortlessly into a chef-inspired kitchen showcasing sleek cabinetry, striking fixtures, premium appl, breakfast bar & walk-in pantry. Ductless A/C adds year-round comfort, while a stylish powder room & spectacular wraparound patio courtyard make hosting a delight. The 2nd level offers 2 spacious guest bedrooms, a beautifully appointed full bath & a dedicated laundry rm with W/D. Above it all, the entire 3rd floor is devoted to an extraordinary primary retreat. Vaulted ceilings & sun-filled southern windows create an airy ambiance, complemented by 2 generous walk-in closets & a spa-inspired ensuite featuring custom finishes, lrg dual-sink vanity, oversized walk-in shower, & private water closet. Just steps away, your own covered rooftop balcony awaits, complete w/custom flooring & recessed lighting-an idyllic setting for morning coffee, evening relaxation or memorable gatherings. A private off-street parking space completes this exceptional offering. Convenient access to shopping, dining, live music, Golden Gardens, Fremont, DT Seattle, I-5 & Hwy 99. Modern luxury, effortless convenience & an enviable Seattle lifestyle-all in one remarkable home!

From Influx Development, welcome to this sweet contemporary Craftsman cottage in Whittier Heights. Sunny main floor includes open concept living, dining and kitchen for both effortless entertaining and functional everyday living. Powder room offers simplicity for guests and hosting. Upstairs, relax in your spacious primary suite with two additional bedrooms or offices, full bath and dedicated laundry. Attached EV-ready garage finishes this beautifully appointed home. This central neighborhood allows access to the outdoors and recreation, with Shilshole, Golden Gardens, and the Burke-Gilman all within reach, plus dining options abound and top-rated schools are all accessible within blocks.

Tucked along a quiet street in Seattle's Sunset Hill neighborhood, this well-cared-for 1945 Cape Cod offers 3 bedrooms, 1.75 baths, and a flexible two-level layout. Natural light fills the main living room, where hardwood floors and a wood-burning fireplace lend warmth and character. A spacious kitchen with stainless steel appliances and two bedrooms complete the main level. Downstairs, a second living room, a full kitchen, and the third bedroom give the home a duplex-style layout that works well for extended stays or multigenerational living. There's room to update the interiors at your own pace. Outside, enjoy a private backyard and generous off-street parking. Take a morning stroll to Caffe Fiore, catch the sunset at Sunset Hill Park, or spend an afternoon at Golden Gardens. Neighborhood restaurants are also an easy walk away.

Tucked along a quiet street in Seattle's Sunset Hill neighborhood, this 1945 Cape Cod pairs classic character with the chance to make it your own. The 3-bedroom, 1.75-bath home is ready for a full refresh, with hardwood floors and a wood-burning fireplace anchoring the light-filled main living room. A spacious kitchen and two bedrooms round out the main level. Downstairs, the third bedroom and a flexible bonus room give you space for a home office, media room, or hobbies. Outside, a private backyard and generous off-street parking offer room to spread out. Stroll to Caffe Fiore for your morning coffee, catch the sunset at Sunset Hill Park, or spend an afternoon at Golden Gardens. Neighborhood restaurants are also an easy walk away.

Timeless charm meets thoughtful modern design on a quiet street in beloved Loyal Heights. A crisp white exterior, charming awnings, a rose-lined entry & fenced front yard offers a warm welcome. Inside, a generous, sun-filled living rm anchored by a stone FP adjoins the dining which rests within walls of windows filtering gorgeous natural light. Beautifully appointed kitchen pairs timeless cabinetry w striking stone that flows from counters to backsplash, while a distinctive stone-clad island plus pantry add character & everyday functionality. Pass through the light-filled hallway leading to the bedroom wing w an expansive slider offering private deck access - a special space for lingering gatherings under twinkling lights. Serene primary retreat w its own FP, spacious walk-in & 5-piece bath layered w marble, custom tile & a warm oak dbl vanity. 5th bed offers flexibility for office or additional living space. Downstairs, tall ceilings, new finishes & a tiled FP make the lower level feel equally inviting, w 2 more beds & a new full bath where rich burgundy tile brings depth alongside marble floors. New electrical, plumbing & more plus a thoughtfully redesigned layout & curated fixtures bring lasting value, while a detached garage w alley access adds convenience. 1 year home warranty provided! From afternoons at Loyal Heights Playfield to sunsets at beach walks at Golden Gardens, plus award-winning schools, this is a home that invites you to settle in & savor the neighborhood.

Exceptional financing opportunity! The builder has secured the BEST and most competitive rate lock, 4.875%! Inquire with listing agents for details. Experience elevated NW living in this stunning new home by AM Homes Northwest, ideally located in coveted Sunset Hills. This light-filled 4-bed, 2.5-bath home features an open layout w/expansive windows that showcase spectacular Pacific NW views while filling the home with natural light. Rooftop entertaining terrace, with a wet bar & beverage refrigerator, creates an unforgettable space for relaxing & hosting. The chef's kitchen offers luxury Bellmont cabinetry, Bertazzoni gas range, a spacious pantry, & an oversized island designed for gathering. The private top-floor primary suite captures breathtaking Mount Rainier & Space Needle views, while the spa-inspired bath features heated tile floors. An additional third-floor bedroom is ideal for a home office or guests. Additional highlights include a fully fenced & landscaped yard, whole-house air conditioning, designated parking w/EV charging, & the exceptional craftsmanship AM Homes Northwest is known for while including a 4-year builder warranty, & a transferable insured 2-10 structural warranty. Minutes from Ballard's acclaimed restaurants, boutique shopping, the Ballard Farmers Market, Golden Gardens Beach, Shilshole Bay Marina, & convenient transit, this home offers exceptional design, remarkable views, & one of Seattle's most desirable locations

A quiet sense of calm defines this fully remodeled home tucked between Sunset Hill and Loyal Heights, where warm materials and clean lines come together with ease. Designed by a Korean-French architect around one simple idea, "keep only what matters," the interiors feature Zen-inspired doors, linear lighting, recessed detailing, warm wood accents, and a feature window that frames the sky. The house lives remarkably large, with an open flow that makes each space feel generous and purposeful. Renewed inside and out: new roof, insulation, feature window, water heater, and a mini-split system for efficient heating and air conditioning. A new kitchen and appliances, baths with heated floors, and engineered wood floors throughout. Fresh, cohesive, and truly move-in ready. Outside, enjoy long summer evenings on the patio, added parking on grass pavers, and easy access to Sunset Hill Park, Golden Gardens, Ballard's shops and restaurants, and highly regarded schools. Simplicity can still feel warm, spacious, and deeply inviting. Come feel it for yourself.

Wonderful opportunity in Sunset Hill to own this large 5100+ square foot corner lot with an alley in back. Current home is a 1909 Craftsman with 2 bedrooms and 1 bath, living room, dining room, kitchen with breakfast nook, plus unfinished basement and attic. Much of the original character has been retained in the box beam ceilings, millwork, built-ins with stained glass, and original wood flooring. This beautiful lot has plenty of space to bring your imagination and plans for a future home in west Ballard. Don't miss out on this unbeatable location near all Ballard has to offer: close to the Ballard Locks, Adams Elementary, Golden Gardens, the National Nordic Museum, and all there is to experience in downtown Ballard, from the year-round Sunday farmer's market and excellent shopping, to the plentiful restaurants, cafes, music venues and many more neighborhood amenities! Property sold AS IS - estate sale.

In the heart of Ballard, enjoy a piece of Seattle history with this 1912 Craftsman. Carefully restored with modern updates, heat pump, mini splits, tankless water heater, newer roof and siding this charming home will last another generation! The natural light is generous, pouring into the living and dining spaces. The Kitchen supports entertainment like no other home of this era. A large quartz island, wine fridge and updated appliances. One of the three bedrooms is staged as an office which is on the main level. Two more bedrooms are situated behind the informal living room, with its own electric fireplace. The lower level has good ceiling height, with space for an art studio, exercise or turn it into a non-conforming bedroom. The very top level has been finished, with additional storage under the roof line, and it exits onto your covered porch. The backyard is private and spacious. Enjoy relaxing on your private back deck and enjoy the sunsets with a glass of wine. Rare two car huge garage with enough space for projects or exercise equipment. All of this is just a short walk to Ballard's vibrant shops, restaurants, parks and transit.

Breathtaking views of the Olympic Mountains & Puget Sound overwhelm this west-facing, Sunset Hill craftsman home. Situated on a spacious, corner lot, 4 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms span across 3 levels, including an unfinished basement w/endless potential. Beautifully restored hardwoods, charming built-ins, elegant cove ceilings & classic archways honor the home's timeless character, while updated systems offer modern-day comfort and peace of mind. Expansive living room windows frame the snow-capped peaks & shimmering water, while a cozy, gas fireplace invites you to settle in and savor the moment. A covered porch, positioned off the formal dining room & kitchen, offers an idyllic setting for watching the evening skies over the Sound transform at sunset. Rounding out the main level are two generous bedrooms and a full bath. Upstairs, 2 additional bedrooms offer their own distinctive charm- one showcasing spectacular views, while the other boasts soaring vaulted ceilings & skylights bathing the room in natural light. Higher ceilings in the unfinished basement provide an opportunity to create additional living spaces: rec room, guest suite, home gym? A fully-fenced backyard offers plenty of room for entertaining, gardening or playing + a 1 car garage w/ storage & driveway parking. Sunset Hill offers an exceptionally walkable lifestyle, with neighborhood restaurants, cozy coffee shops, beautiful parks, and convenient public transportation just blocks away. Welcome Home!

Turn-of-the-century Sunset Hill duplex perfectly situated on a bright and sunny corner lot! This rare property offers two units with highly desirable, similar layouts, making it an incredible investment, or owner occupant opportunity. The lower unit features two spacious bedrooms and one bath, highlighted by an updated kitchen, a large dining area with a cozy freestanding gas parlor stove, a spacious living room with classic built-ins, and private laundry. The upper unit offers two bedrooms, a 3/4 bath, and a sunny kitchen with gas cooking that boasts peek city and territorial views. Outside, the property shines with a beautiful mix of garden/yard space and a huge patio designed for outdoor entertaining, plus a detached double garage currently utilized for convenient unit storage. Nestled in a premier location, you are just moments away from Golden Gardens, the historic Ballard Locks, and vibrant Downtown Ballard.

Discover timeless Seattle charm and exceptional versatility in this inviting Sunset Hill residence! Offering over 2,000 square feet of finished living space, this classic 1941 home blends character, comfort, and an enviable location in one of Ballard's most desirable neighborhoods. The updated kitchen brings modern convenience to everyday living, while generous gathering spaces offer room to relax, entertain, and work from home. A welcoming living room anchored by a beautiful fireplace creates an inviting setting for quiet evenings or lively get-togethers. Downstairs, the finished lower level adds valuable flexibility for recreation, hobbies, guests, or a home office. Three bedrooms provide comfortable accommodations, and the thoughtful layout offers opportunities to personalize the home to suit your lifestyle. Situated on an approximately 5,700-square-foot lot, the property offers outdoor space for gardening, entertaining, and enjoying the Pacific Northwest seasons. Just minutes from Golden Gardens Park, Sunset Hill Park, Ballard Locks, vibrant restaurants and shops, cafes, local markets, and the popular Ballard Farmers Market. Enjoy waterfront recreation, scenic sunsets, and convenient connections to downtown Seattle and surrounding neighborhoods. Whether you're drawn to the updated kitchen, flexible finished living areas, or sought-after Sunset Hill setting, this home delivers a compelling combination of space, charm, and location. Your next chapter starts here!

Timeless character, a private setting, and exceptional potential come together at 831 NW 52nd St. Set back from the street, this cedar-shingled Ballard cottage offers a welcoming retreat with a deep backyard ready to be reimagined for gardening, entertaining, or quiet outdoor living. Original hardwood floors, built-in shelving, period lighting, and vintage architectural details preserve the home's authentic charm. Updated plumbing and electrical, including an electrical panel replaced in the early 2000s, provide a starting point for your next chapter. The efficient floor plan lends itself to a thoughtful renovation that blends classic character with modern comfort. For investors or buyers looking to build equity, this is an opportunity to bring fresh vision to an established Seattle neighborhood. Sold as-is, with pre-offer inspections welcomed. Cash, hard money, and other renovation financing may be suitable, subject to property and buyer eligibility. Ideally located between Ballard and Fremont, with convenient access to Downtown Seattle, South Lake Union, and major commuter routes. Nearby Ballard Avenue, the Sunday Farmers Market, parks, breweries, cafes, and restaurants offer plenty to explore. Planned Ballard Link light rail adds to the area's long-term appeal. Property is an estate property being sold as is, no Form 17 shall be provided. Current zoning is (NR3). Buyer to conduct any and all independent study(s). Property has a fill pipe for oil heat, likely oil tank below, flooring materials may be determined to have asbestos based on the date of construction.

Discover the charm of Seattle living in Ballard's Loyal Heights neighborhood! Tucked away on a quiet street, this charming 1930s home beautifully blends timeless character with thoughtful modern updates. Sun-filled living spaces, hardwood floors, a cozy dining nook & vaulted primary bedroom create a warm, inviting atmosphere. The European-inspired bathroom offers a spa-like retreat with heated tile floors, while mini-split heating & A/C provide year-round comfort. The finished lower level features a kitchenette, additional living space & both interior and exterior access, offering wonderful flexibility for guests, a home office or potential rental opportunities. Step outside to a large, level, fully fenced backyard perfect for dining, gardening, entertaining or relaxing. A 5,100-sq-ft lot, detached one-car garage & ample off-street parking add convenience. Enjoy neighborhood coffee shops, bakeries, parks & transit. Downtown Ballard & the iconic Ballard Locks are approximately a 15-minute walk, while Golden Gardens Park is just a five-minute drive for kayaking, paddleboarding, beachside campfires & breathtaking Puget Sound sunsets. Neighborhood favorites include Tall Grass Bakery, Mabel's Coffee & Picolino's. Classic Seattle charm, flexible living & an unbeatable neighborhood lifestyle-all in one special home!

Soaring ceilings, graceful arches and sunshine - this 1910 Craftsman knows how to make an entrance! A covered front porch overlooks a fenced, south-facing yard ready for gardening, gatherings and fur babies. Inside, a proper entry and gorgeous hardwoods welcome you into beautifully connected living spaces. Large living room windows bring in abundant natural light, making it easy to settle in with coffee and a good book. Whip up meals in the sunny kitchen with butcher block counters, under-cabinet lighting, stainless appliances and a crisp subway tile backsplash. A generous dining room for hosting loved ones and a full bath complete the main floor. Upstairs you'll find three bedrooms, each with a walk-in closet, plus mini-splits for year-round comfort. A stunning 3/4 bath features heated floors, marble tile and under-cabinet lighting. The finished lower level offers a fourth bedroom, bonus room, laundry room, and half bath. Rest easy knowing major systems have been brought into the new century: updated electrical, plumbing, double-pane windows, and a heat pump. Tucked into Ballard's coveted West Woodland neighborhood, this unbeatable location puts the best of Ballard, Phinney Ridge and Fremont at your fingertips, from fav coffee shops, dining hotspots, and breweries, to parks and farmers markets. Ditch the car for everyday errands and enjoy an easy-breezy bike or bus commute downtown.

Views, charm, livability, convenience, all in one attractive home. Multiple west-facing decks deliver a commanding perspective over Ballard with the Olympic Mountains as a backdrop, the perfect setting for watching the seasons change. Inside, 1926 character meets thoughtful updates. The front room features a perfect-blue color wash, period wood-burning fireplace and built-ins, and open dining room with plentiful windows and stylish lighting. The remodeled kitchen is efficient and bespoke, with quartz counters, white shaker cabinetry, subway tile, stainless appliances, a Fisher & Paykel range, and a sunny breakfast nook with heated terracotta floor. Two bedrooms and a full bath complete the main level. Upstairs, find a generous primary bedroom with ensuite bath and a guest bedroom with built-in shelving and westerly view; this could double as an office space. The finished lower level adds valuable bonus space for a rec room, media room, home office, or play area. Outside, a fully fenced yard with patio, pergola, and terraced garden invites easy outdoor living. Just steps to West Woodland Elementary and a few blocks to the shops, restaurants, and pubs of Ballard and Phinney Ridge, this is a laid-back Seattle neighborhood where life happens outdoors and neighbors know each other.

Beach club membership not required. The water is yours and the afternoon changes shape. At 647 NW 51st Street, a private swimming pool turns a classic Ballard home into The Frelard Pool House, enriched by a cabana and dressing area, private guest suite, wet bar, entertaining spaces and indoor sauna. Behind the laughter, wet feet and one-more-swim afternoons, the house keeps everything grounded. Living spaces hold the daily pattern. Bedrooms give everyone a place to land. The kitchen anchors movement between living, dining and the backyard. Lower-level spaces add flexibility for guests, work, play or longer stays. The supporting spaces keep the day going. The cabana and dressing area give pool days a proper landing zone: a place to change, drop a bag, reset between swims and stay outside longer. The wet bar keeps drinks, snacks and conversation close to the action. The guest suite gives visitors a reason to stay, and the indoor sauna brings warmth and comfort into colder months. Near the meeting point of Ballard, Fremont, Phinney and Greenwood, The Frelard Pool House keeps restaurants, breweries, parks, errands and transit close, while giving home its own reason to gather. A classic Seattle house with a way of living rarely found in the city.

Fenced back yard.

Storybook Tudor Charm in the Heart of Ballard. Nestled on a picturesque street filled with Old World charm and character, this enchanting 1931 Tudor welcomes you with timeless architectural details and distinctive craftsmanship. Inside, discover quarter-sawn oak floors, graceful archways, coved ceilings, an Art Deco fireplace, original millwork, mahogany doors, vintage hardware, and light-catching crystal doorknobs. Enjoy the best of the Ballard lifestyle, with the famous Ballard Farmers Market, neighborhood shops, restaurants, and transit all within walking distance. An energy-efficient heat pump provides year-round comfort, with the added benefit of air conditioning. Non-conforming 3rd bedroom & large utility room with 2nd-bath conversion potential. A rare opportunity to own a distinctive. And apparently, the backyard has caught the attention of a local celebrity! Jimothy, the neighborhood's much-loved raccoon, has made an appearance on the Ring camera. Clearly, he has excellent taste in real estate.

text: Beautifully crafted townhome nestled in a peaceful setting in the heart of Ballard. Create your own outdoor living room, host friends, dine under the stars or simply unwind while taking in views of the Ship Canal to the south and Puget Sound. NO HOA DUES!

address: 5440 Leary Ave NW Unit 330, Seattle, WA
text: Walk everywhere from this Ballard retreat! Freshly updated with brand-new carpet, fresh paint, new lighting and fixtures, and a new washer and dryer. Standout amenities include an on-site concierge and office manager, fitness center, sauna and spa, conference rooms, and community space, plus a secure, private courtyard for entertaining or quiet time. Steps to the Ballard Farmers Market, transit, groceries, and the best restaurants and bars. Well-funded HOA and a track record as a successful rental. Ideal as a primary home or pied-a-terre.
